rules.statement: A co-owner's possession of a separate lot alone is not sufficient to establish title by prescription; there must be proof of circumstances from which a reasonable inference could be drawn that such possession had become adverse at some date ten years before action was brought.
rules.supporting_quote: "For these reasons, I am of the opinion that the plaintiff has failed to establish title by prescription to the land in suit. The appeal is accordingly allowed, the judgment and decree of the District Court are set aside and the plaintiff's action is dismissed with costs."
